_note: Random magic item placement (story/treasure.gd, ADR 0012). The party's level in each region (from the region design docs) decides the rarities, following the 2024 DMG's treasure guidance: tier 1 (levels 1-4) mostly common and uncommon items, tier 2 (levels 5-10) mostly uncommon and rare with the odd very rare one. A location can name its own level with "treasure_level". No common items (owner, 2026-10-08: early commons become uncommon, later ones rarer): the DMG's common share goes to uncommon.
_shop_note: Merchants' magic stock (story/trade.gd magic_stock; Ashwin, 2026-10-14): an item shows once the party's milestone level reaches its rarity's level here (common and uncommon from the start), the tiers found treasure follows (docs/story/found_magic_items.md), so a level 1 party in the village finds nothing rare for sale. Prices are Sane Magical Prices (magic_prices.json).
_loot_note: Owner, 2026-10-12: loot felt light. A place with chests now holds 0-2 random magic items (1.4 on average) plus one more half the time with three or more chests, and 0-2 potions besides: a healing potion for the party's tier (healing share in percent) or else any potion of the place's rarity. Story fights leave coins by each foe's Challenge Rating and a find, as road fights do (RoadSpoils).
_theme_note: A roll picks a rarity, then a theme (arcana, armaments, implements, relics) evenly, then an item in it by weight. A theme whose pool at that rarity weighs less than theme_full_weight gets a share in proportion, so a theme with one or two items doesn't hand them out in a quarter of all rolls (owner, 2026-10-12).
_distinct_note: Each lasting magic item turns up once (Ashwin, 2026-10-17: the Amulet of the Devout was found six times). Random treasure never rolls a kind of item the story places anywhere (a find, a hoard, a gift or a reward) or one already rolled this playthrough or carried by the party (story/treasure.gd taken_kinds). A kind (Treasure.kind_of): a +1, +2 or +3 of one item, or variants that work the same way (Belt of Giant Strength, Ring of Resistance, Bag of Tricks, Instruments of the Bards), are one kind, except the `distinct_variants`, which do different things; a plain +N weapon, armor or shield counts by its base (`kind_by_base`: a +1 and a +2 Longsword are one kind, a +1 Rapier another); any other item made on a base by its template. Consumables (potions, scrolls, ammunition, oils, dusts) repeat. tests/unit/test_loot_distinct.gd checks the story's own placements.
_support_note: Found treasure leans to combat (Ashwin, 2026-10-17: the magic items we find should be combat focused, with a mix for every class). These items do nothing in a fight (travel, carrying, scouting, social and household magic); a random roll weighs each at `support_weight` of an ordinary item's chance, so they still turn up now and then. The audit behind the list: docs/story/magic_item_audit.md.
